The main takeaway from our work is that
the luminescence of nanowires can be directly related to their 3D structure, which can be determined by tomographic imaging, allowing the design of nanowires with optimized luminescence properties.

the luminescence from QWT nanowired can be used as an effective probe for the characterization of nanowire structure, which is of paramount importance for their applications as nanoscale light sources.
